author: luther
title: A Commentary on Saint Paul's Epistle to the Galatians
edition: Philadelphia: John Highlands, 1891, reprinting the English translation of 1575 (revised); archive.org scan "cu31924029294141" (Cornell University Library), djvu OCR text
translation: The English translation of 1575 by "certain godly learned men" (unnamed), commended by Edwin Sandys, Bishop of London, in a later revised form (to confirm: probably Erasmus Middleton's revision of 1807)

rights.worldwide: public domain: the 1575 translators and the 1807 reviser died long ago; the 1891 printing's editor, if any, is still to identify

notes: From Luther's lectures of 1531, published in Latin in 1535. Not Theodore Graebner's abridged translation (1939), which CCEL and Project Gutenberg carry and which is too late for Logia. The 1891 printing's revision of the 1575 translation is to be confirmed against the 1807 edition. One excerpt per lemma ("Verse 4. Which gave himself for our sins."), up to about 350 words and cut at a sentence end; Luther often comments on one verse under several lemmas. A sentence the OCR damaged is left out and marked " ... "; misreadings are corrected in library/corrections/luther.json only where the same scan prints the word correctly many times.
